Definition: A TASK skill that identifies visible figures, tables, and meaningful images on one rasterized prose PDF page and emits bbox-normalized asset records.
The orchestrator that spawns pdf2md-page-assets and runs deterministic downstream asset tools.
Runtime override for the absolute path to the page PNG.
Runtime override for the absolute path to cleaned per-page Markdown.
Runtime override for the absolute path to the page asset JSON.
Document stem used by downstream deterministic naming tools.
The 1-indexed page number.
The total page count of the document.
Optional policy label that defaults to prose-document-assets-v1 and is echoed into JSON.
A four-element JSON array [x0, y0, x1, y1] in normalized top-left-origin page coordinates.
Asset kind for captioned figures, diagrams, plots, charts, plates, or illustrations.
Asset kind for tabular data that should exist as a structured auditable artifact.
Asset kind for meaningful non-figure images such as logos, covers, photographs, or uncaptioned visual objects.
The structured canonical hashable representation for legibly extractable table assets.
The required schema_version value for table_data blocks.
Boolean required on visible table assets whose cells cannot be safely transcribed.
The only accepted asset field for a visible caption or concise visual description.
An advisory short ASCII-friendly asset slug that downstream tools normalize.
Output JSON status field constrained to SUCCESS, NO_ASSETS, FAILED, or FAILED_INPUTS.
Top-level flat JSON array containing asset entries.
Top-level JSON list that may be empty and carries problems such as table_unreadable.
Required table_data integer counting leading header rows.
Required table_data array of row indices where visible internal section breaks appear.
Required table_data field that is null for standalone tables or identifies an earlier continued table.
Required table_data array of marker and text objects referenced by cell footnote markers.
Optional table cell span count that defaults to 1 and is omitted when 1.
Optional table cell span count that defaults to 1 and is omitted when 1.
Optional table cell boolean that marks header cells for renderer bolding.
Optional table cell list whose entries must match table-level footnotes markers.
Legacy table output field that must not be emitted because table_data is canonical.
Tool that only rewrites canonical inline asset placeholder shapes and warns on drift.
Downstream tool that crops images, delegates table XLSX rendering, and writes anchored page Markdown.
